products.name: Insight® Ergo Phlebotomy Cart with Tracking Caster
products.brand: Marketlab
products.description:
Enhance Maneuverability and Reduce User Fatigue During Long Shifts

Tracking caster enhances control to reduce draft, twisting or corrections
Ergonomic handle is ideal for taller users and enables easier maneuverability
5" medical-grade casters are durable and move easily and quietly
Three tilt bins provide quick and easy access to key supplies
Choose all drawers or a mix of drawers and bulk storage area
Modular rail system allows easy height adjustment of optional accessories
Key or electronic lock to secure supplies
Easily clean with soap and water or hospital-grade cleaner
1-year limited warranty

LIMITED-TIME REBATE: Get Up to $150 Back
Purchase an Insight Ergo Phlebotomy Cart with Tracking Caster between October 1 and December 31, 2026 to save.

Offer Details:
Key lock model (108687): Get $100 back
Electronic lock model (108687E): Get $150 back

Rebate Submission Deadline: February 28, 2027

For more information or to submit your rebate, visit the rebate page.

Effortless Mobility: The Insight Phlebotomy Cart, equipped with a precision tracking caster, glides smoothly through hospital corridors, navigates tight spaces with ease, and crosses thresholds effortlessly. It delivers the modular storage options and functionality you need, with enhanced maneuverability that alleviates the physical strain on phlebotomists. When engaged, the tracking caster requires only a fraction of the effort to maneuver. This innovative feature enhances control and tracking, while also reducing drift, twisting, or corrections, making the cart feel more stable and responsive under load.

A tracking caster combines both functions: it can switch between swivel and fixed/tracking mode.

Straight-line control – Keeps carts moving straight when pushed down long corridors.

Reduced operator fatigue – Staff don’t have to constantly correct direction; the cart “tracks” with minimal effort.

Improved safety – Prevents carts from veering into walls, equipment, or patients.

Ease of navigation – Allows staff to switch between “tracking mode” for hallways and "free swivel" for tight patient rooms or procedure areas.

Smooth transport – Especially useful for heavier carts and fully loaded carts that need stable, predictable motion.

Intentionally designed with valuable features, including the choice of a key lock or e-lock, Insight carts help enhance efficiency and security compared to performing rounds with just a phlebotomy tray. The large worksurface and purpose-built features help facilitate blood draws, while the durable frame is built to withstand even the busiest phlebotomy departments, giving you a hardworking solution that goes everywhere you do.

products.name: Traceable® Thermohygrometer with Clock
products.brand: Marketlab
products.description:
Monitor Temperature, Humidity, and Time Simultaneously, at a Glance

All three parameters are displayed on screen, all the time, so you can log conditions without putting down your clipboard
Staff onboarding is a breeze with an enhanced, more intuitive user experience including large buttons, high-contrast text, and purposeful design
Reduce upkeep with boosted battery power and interior tech upgrades for higher performance
Features Min/Max memory, which is easily cleared at the beginning of each process
Maintain compliance; includes NIST-traceable certificate from our A2LA accredited (1750.01) calibration laboratory
Goes anywhere, whether magnetically mounted or set on the benchtop with built-in kickstand

Clock displays AM/PM or 24-hour military time to the exact minute with ±0.01% accuracy. Noting changes is easy with triple display. Internal sensors make it ideal for use in hoods, storerooms, cleanrooms, incubators, drying chambers, and environmental cabinets. Temperature range is 32.0 to 122.0°F (0.0 to 50.0°C); resolution is 0.1° and accuracy is ±1°C. Relative humidity range is 20 to 90%; resolution is 1% RH and accuracy is ±5% RH mid-range, otherwise 8%. At the touch of a button, memory recalls highest and lowest temperature and humidity readings. Permits monitoring conditions overnight, on weekends, or any time period.
What You Get: Traceable® Thermohygrometer with Clock

Recalibration reminder magnet
Traceable certificate
AAA batteries
Quick start guide
